shortDescription: A potential strike at the Port of Los Angeles was deferred again after the union representing about 250 security workers at the busiest US ports agreed to continue labor contract negotiations for two more weeks, employers said, according to Bloomberg.

title: Los Angeles Port Strike Threat Delayed as Labor Talks Get Two-Week Extension
